title: BUG / DEV-M / DASH History button restarts AAPS
body:
When I look at the DASH history, AAPS restarts (I see the AAPS icon and then the main page with the progress bar etc). First found by @ohjay

![Screenshot_20231001_100512_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/a6c748a6-afa6-4cda-9a78-36b44363cc61)

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1696214180512.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12779212/AndroidAPS_LOG_1696214180512.log.zip)

To all that have commented and added logs.

Please try to use pod history again. It started working for me but I did nothing new... I didn't start a new pod. I just rebooted the phone but no idea if this is related. Now, pod history works.

The bug got solved all by itself... Not normal.

For me, the PR is a _go for merge_
